indications.description: Adults with locally advanced/metastatic NSCLC with activating EGFR mutations

treatment.schedule_summary: 250 mg once daily continuously until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
administration_instructions: 250 mg by mouth once daily, with or without food, at about the same time.
If a dose is missed, take it when remembered unless less than 12 hours remain to the next dose; then skip. Never double.

For swallowing difficulty, disperse without crushing in non-carbonated water; swirl until dispersed (may take 20 minutes), drink within 60 minutes and rinse the glass with half a glass of water. Pharmacy must supervise tube administration.

regular: FBC, renal and liver profile throughout treatment as clinically indicated.
Prompt assessment of diarrhoea, dehydration, skin, respiratory, eye or liver symptoms; regular INR/PT with warfarin.
disease: Disease monitoring and scans per supervising Consultant plan.

dose_modifications: Only the currently structured inputs and decision rules are operational in SACTCheck. Renal and hepatic source requirements may still require manual review of the current official NCCP PDF.

source_conflicts: NCCP Child–Pugh B/C 50% dose versus EMA close-monitoring approach: no automatic 125 mg dose; pharmacy/Consultant prescription required.
NCCP expects no renal/dialysis adjustment; EMA cautions at CrCl ≤20 because data are limited.
NCCP excludes pregnancy; EMA allows only when clearly necessary. The narrower NCCP eligibility is retained.
